verdict.rationale: The IRS's published online-account sign-in requires identity proofing through ID.me. The IRS's own page cites selfie, video and biometric data, which is a liveness check rather than credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely. Signed online forms such as Form 15620 also sit behind that same Online Account wall. The pack documents no alternative credential-MFA-only sign-in path, so this applicable axis is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
